messages.subject: Clean Energy Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Strategic Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Alchemy Energy Partners Team,

Your global clean-energy executive-search work across LNG, hydrogen, power, renewables and low-carbon solutions aligns with my international leadership profile. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibilities spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am exploring Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where energy development depends on regulatory alignment, stakeholder trust and disciplined execution. I am internationally mobile, with Saudi Arabia and the UAE among my priority markets.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
